engineered_feature_dictionary.formula: sum_{t in {0,2,3,4,5,6}} I(PAY_t_DPD >= 1), where PAY_t_DPD = max(PAY_t, 0)
engineered_feature_dictionary.description: Count of months in the 6-month observation window (Apr-Sep 2005) with 1+ months past due (30+ DPD).

engineered_feature_dictionary.formula: sum_{t in {0,2,3,4,5,6}} I(PAY_t_DPD >= 2), where PAY_t_DPD = max(PAY_t, 0)
engineered_feature_dictionary.description: Count of months in the 6-month window with 2+ months past due (60+ DPD).
Worst (maximum) delinquency severity in months past due across the 6-month window.
Count of months where the cardholder used revolving credit (paid minimum due on time, PAY_t == 0).
Count of months with no credit card consumption / inactive status (PAY_t == -2).

engineered_feature_dictionary.divide_by_zero_handling: Denominator protected via limit_safe = max(LIMIT_BAL, 1.0) plus DQ03 hard quarantine (LIMIT_BAL <= 0); ratio clipped to [-1.0, 5.0].
engineered_feature_dictionary.description: 6-month average statement balance divided by credit limit.

engineered_feature_dictionary.divide_by_zero_handling: Denominator protected via limit_safe = max(LIMIT_BAL, 1.0) plus DQ03 hard quarantine (LIMIT_BAL <= 0); ratio clipped to [-1.0, 5.0].
engineered_feature_dictionary.description: Most recent month (September 2005) statement balance divided by credit limit.

engineered_feature_dictionary.divide_by_zero_handling: Denominator protected via limit_safe = max(LIMIT_BAL, 1.0) plus DQ03 hard quarantine (LIMIT_BAL <= 0); ratio clipped to [-2.0, 2.0].
engineered_feature_dictionary.description: 6-month balance change (Sep 2005 minus Apr 2005) normalised by credit limit.

engineered_feature_dictionary.formula: clip( sum_{k=1}^{6} PAY_AMT_k / sum_{k=1}^{6} max(BILL_AMT_k, 0), 0.0, 2.0 ) if sum_{k=1}^{6} max(BILL_AMT_k, 0) > 0 else 1.0
engineered_feature_dictionary.divide_by_zero_handling: Explicitly guarded by np.where(SUM_BILL_POS_6M > 0, ..., 1.0): when 6-month positive billed balances sum to zero, the ratio defaults to 1.0 (100% paid / no unpaid positive bill); otherwise clipped to [0.0, 2.0].
engineered_feature_dictionary.description: Ratio of total 6-month repayments to total 6-month positive billed balances.

engineered_feature_dictionary.divide_by_zero_handling: Denominator protected via 6.0 * max(LIMIT_BAL, 1.0) plus DQ03 hard quarantine (LIMIT_BAL <= 0); ratio clipped to [0.0, 2.0].
engineered_feature_dictionary.description: Ratio of total 6-month repayments to 6 months of total credit limit exposure.

pay_0_bin1_vs_bin2_separation_note: PAY_0 Bin 1 ((-inf, -1.5], i.e. PAY_0 == -2 'no consumption / inactive', DEV n=1,926, bad rate=12.88%, WoE=+0.6553, 96 pts) and Bin 2 ((-1.5, 0.5], i.e. PAY_0 == -1 'paid duly' and PAY_0 == 0 'revolving minimum paid', DEV n=14,259, bad rate=13.73%, WoE=+0.5811, 93 pts) are kept separate rather than merged for three credit-governance reasons: (1) Both bins comfortably exceed the 5% minimum population threshold on DEV (9.19% and 68.06% respectively); (2) They exhibit strictly monotonic risk ordering on both DEV (12.88% < 13.73%) and HOLDOUT (14.09% < 14.41%), awarding +3 scorecard points to inactive/zero-balance accounts over active revolving/transacting accounts; (3) Domain/behavioural distinctness: PAY_0 == -2 represents dormant accounts with zero statement consumption, whereas PAY_0 in {-1, 0} represents active credit users who carry or settle statement balances. Preserving this distinction maintains granular behavioural auditability in the scorecard.
